scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@college-erp/shared && cd apps/web && npm run build
scripts.build:server: npm run build --workspace=@college-erp/shared && cd apps/server && npm run build
scripts.db:push: cd apps/server && npx prisma db push
scripts.db:migrate: cd apps/server && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:seed: cd apps/server && npx prisma db seed
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd apps/server && npm install && cd ../web && npm install
